blurb: Papillon Grand Canyon Helicopter Tours operates daily tours over the Grand Canyon with exclusive landing sites on the canyon floor. Their helicopters have oversized windows and onboard upgrades for sightseeing and comfort. Tours depart from Grand Canyon National Park, Las Vegas, and other locations, offering various flight durations and experiences including canyon floor landings and views of Hoover Dam and Lake Mead.
